desc:
💰 GUESS THE PRICE! 💰

Think you know how much things cost? Prove it! Sit down at a table, face an opponent and guess the real price of hundreds of real items: phones, sneakers, supercars, snacks and more!

🎯 HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a table: Electronics 📱, Fashion 👟, Cars 🏎️ or Food 🍔
• See the item, type your guess and lock it in before time runs out!
• The closest guess wins the round and zaps the other player with a laser!
• Knock out all of your opponent’s hearts to win the match!

✨ FEATURES
• 390+ real items with real prices
• Play with friends, or press “Play Bots” anytime
• Earn Cash for every round you win
• 40+ chairs to collect
• 20 epic Win Effects
• Power-Ups: Reveal the price, +20 seconds, +1 life, and silly trolls like Blind and Jumpscare!
• Daily Rewards: come back every day for bigger prizes!

🏆 Climb the Wins leaderboard and become the ultimate price guesser!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE Cat Paw Chair!
